senses.gloss: रधुनाथ a grammarian of the seven- teenth century, who was a pupil of Bhattoji Diksita and who wrote a small gloss ( लधुभाष्य ) on the topic named ' पञ्चसंधि ' of the Sidd- hantakaumudf.
राधाकृष्ण ( गोस्वामी ) a grammarian who wrote two elementary gra- umar treatises (1) अव्ययार्थे and (2) वैयाकरणसर्वस्वसूची.
